seoContent.hintSchemaType: Type of structured data, e.g. Vehicle, Organization, WebSite, BreadcrumbList.
seoContent.hintSchemaJson: JSON-LD structured data for search engines. Must be valid JSON. Used for rich results and knowledge panels.
seoContent.hintContentHtml: Optional HTML block for extra SEO content rendered on the page.
seoContent.hintFaqJson: FAQ structured data as a JSON array (question/answer pairs) for FAQ rich results.
seoContent.hintBreadcrumbsJson: Breadcrumb trail as JSON for BreadcrumbList structured data.

help.tabGeneral: Platform-wide UI settings that apply across the public marketplace and the dealer, staff, and admin panel.
help.languageSwitcherEnabled: When enabled, users can switch between Danish and English on the public Laravel site and in the Vue panel. Disable for production if Danish-only is required.
help.tabCrm: CRM notifications and lead hygiene. Controls when dealers are emailed about new leads and when inactive leads are flagged as stale in the pipeline.
help.tabPayment: Stripe powers dealer subscription checkout and billing webhooks. Use test mode while configuring keys; switch to live only when ready for production payments.
help.tabAi: Connect one or more AI providers for dealer-facing assistant features. Dealers need the ai_assistant plan feature. Test each provider after saving keys.
help.tabMedia: Rules for vehicle image uploads and optional watermarking before listings can be published on the marketplace.
help.tabFinance: Monthly payment calculator shown on vehicle detail pages. Set allowed rate ranges and legal disclaimers shown to buyers.
help.tabMarketplace: Buyer-facing marketplace features on public listing pages. Control transparency widgets shown to shoppers.
help.tabMarketing: Automated follow-ups for enquiries and reminders when a buyer abandons a form. WhatsApp clicks can auto-create staff tasks.
help.tabCompliance: GDPR export access and how long platform data is retained. Google Places key powers location or reputation features that call Google APIs.
help.emailOnNewLead: Sends an email to the assigned dealer when a new lead is created from the website or integrations.
help.staleLeadHours: After this many hours without activity, a lead is marked stale so staff can prioritise follow-up.
help.enableStripe: Turns on Stripe Checkout for dealer subscription payments across the platform.
help.instantSubscriptionCheckout: When enabled, dealers can complete subscription checkout immediately without waiting for admin approval (requires Stripe enabled).
help.stripeMode: Test mode uses Stripe test keys and no real charges. Live mode processes real payments.
help.publishableKey: Stripe publishable key (starts with pk_test_ or pk_live_). Safe to use in the browser.
help.secretKey: Stripe secret key (starts with sk_test_ or sk_live_). Stored encrypted; never share publicly.
help.webhookSecret: Signing secret from your Stripe webhook endpoint. Verifies that payment events are genuinely from Stripe.
help.webhookUrl: Add this URL in the Stripe Dashboard under Developers → Webhooks. Required for subscription checkout completion.
help.webhookEvents: In Stripe, subscribe this endpoint to checkout.session.completed so paid subscriptions activate automatically.
help.openai: Enable OpenAI as an AI provider for generated descriptions, prompts, and assistant replies.
help.openaiApiKey: API key from platform.openai.com. Required when OpenAI is enabled.
help.openaiModel: Model ID to use for OpenAI requests, e.g. gpt-4o-mini.
help.anthropic: Enable Anthropic (Claude) as an alternative AI provider.
help.googleGemini: Enable Google Gemini as an AI provider.
help.geminiApiKey: API key from Google AI Studio or Google Cloud.
help.deepseek: Enable DeepSeek as a low-cost AI provider (recommended: deepseek-v4-flash).
help.deepseekApiKey: API key from platform.deepseek.com. Required when DeepSeek is enabled.
help.deepseekModel: Model ID for DeepSeek requests, e.g. deepseek-v4-flash (lightweight) or deepseek-v4-pro.
help.aiMaxTokens: Maximum tokens returned per AI request. Lower values reduce cost; higher allow longer answers.
help.aiTemperature: Creativity of responses (0 = focused, 1 = more varied). Typical values: 0.3–0.7.
help.aiMonthlyTokenBudget: Platform-wide monthly token cap across all dealers. Set to 0 for unlimited usage.
help.testOpenai: Sends a test request to OpenAI using the saved API key and model.
help.testAnthropic: Sends a test request to Anthropic using the saved API key and model.
help.testGemini: Sends a test request to Google Gemini using the saved API key and model.
help.testDeepseek: Sends a test request to DeepSeek using the saved API key and model.
help.editPrompts: Opens the AI prompt template editor where system and user prompts can be customised.
help.minImagesBeforePublish: Minimum number of images a dealer must upload before a vehicle listing can be published.
help.maxImageUploadMb: Maximum file size per image upload in megabytes.
help.watermarkEnabled: Overlays a watermark on vehicle photos when enabled (e.g. dealer branding).
help.calculatorEnabled: Shows the finance calculator widget on public vehicle detail pages.
help.trustReportEnabled: Shows the Bilskyen Trust Report card on public vehicle detail pages, including registration data, inspection history, and fair-price context for buyers.
help.defaultRatePct: Default annual interest rate pre-filled in the calculator.
help.minRatePct: Lowest rate buyers can select in the calculator slider.
help.maxRatePct: Highest rate buyers can select in the calculator slider.
help.defaultTermMonths: Default loan term in months shown on the calculator.
help.disclaimerEn: Legal disclaimer text shown below the calculator on English pages.
help.disclaimerDa: Legal disclaimer text shown below the calculator on Danish pages.
help.enquirySequenceEnabled: Sends automated follow-up emails to buyers after they submit an enquiry.
help.enquiryDay1Hours: Hours after enquiry before the first follow-up email is sent.
help.enquiryDay3Days: Days after enquiry before the second follow-up email is sent.
help.abandonedEnquiryEnabled: Reminds staff or buyers when an enquiry form was started but not submitted.
help.abandonedTimeoutMinutes: Minutes of inactivity before an in-progress enquiry is treated as abandoned.
help.whatsappAutoTask: Creates a staff task when a buyer clicks a WhatsApp contact link from a listing.
help.gdprExportEnabled: Allows users to request a GDPR data export from the platform.
help.dataRetentionDays: How long inactive personal data is kept before automatic deletion or anonymisation.
help.googlePlacesApiKey: Google Places API key for address lookup, maps, or review widgets. Stored securely.
help.testConnection: Tests the active tab’s integration (e.g. Stripe webhook reachability). For AI, use the per-provider test buttons.
help.save: Saves settings for the currently selected tab only.
help.metaSection: Configure the platform Meta Pixel and Conversions API. The catalog feed URL is used for Bilskyen-wide Vehicles catalog ads.
help.metaPixelEnabled: When enabled, Meta Pixel loads on the public site and tracks PageView, ViewContent, and Lead.
help.metaPixelId: Pixel ID from Meta Events Manager. Required for browser and server events.
help.metaCapiAccessToken: Server access token for Conversions API. Stored encrypted. Leave as ******** to keep the existing secret.
help.metaCapiTestEventCode: Optional test code from Events Manager Test Events while verifying CAPI.

placeholders.about_header_description: We are dedicated to revolutionizing the dealership industry with cutting-edge technology and a passion for excellence.

metaAdsGuide.title: Meta Catalog Ads & Marketplace Guide
metaAdsGuide.subtitle: Guide for the Bilskyen platform catalog and Meta Pixel for Catalog Ads and Marketplace
metaAdsGuide.previewFailed: Could not load catalog preview for this vehicle
metaAdsGuide.overviewBody: Use the same vehicle catalog feed for two Meta products. Catalog Ads show cars as inventory cards in paid ads; Marketplace listing can show them in Facebook Marketplace. A click always opens your Bilskyen car detail page.
metaAdsGuide.catalogAdsBlurb: Promote your inventory in Facebook/Instagram ads. Meta shows car cards (photo, title, price). Clicking a car opens that car’s detail URL on Bilskyen.
metaAdsGuide.marketplaceBlurb: List inventory on Facebook Marketplace from the same Vehicles catalog. Requirements are stricter (images, address, mileage).

prerequisites.1: A Meta Business Manager account and access to Commerce Manager.
prerequisites.2: Published vehicles with title, price, images, make, model, and year.
prerequisites.3: A Meta Vehicles catalog connected to your catalog CSV feed URL (shown below).
prerequisites.4: For conversion tracking: Meta Pixel enabled in platform Integrations (admin).

metaAdsGuide.feedBody: Paste this HTTPS CSV URL into Meta Commerce Manager when creating or updating a Vehicles catalog. Meta will fetch it on a schedule.
metaAdsGuide.feedMissing: Platform feed URL is generated automatically. Reload this page, or open Integrations → Marketing.
metaAdsGuide.carSelectorBody: Pick a published vehicle to see the exact catalog row Meta will receive, a readiness checklist, and how the click-through URL looks.
metaAdsGuide.clickThroughExplain: When someone taps this car in an ad or Marketplace, Meta opens the detail URL above on Bilskyen.

catalogSteps.1: In Meta Commerce Manager, create a catalog of type Vehicles.
catalogSteps.2: Add a data source → Scheduled feed → paste your CSV URL: {feedUrl}.
catalogSteps.3: Set refresh interval (hourly or daily) and wait until items are approved.
catalogSteps.4: In Ads Manager, create an Advantage+ catalog / vehicle inventory campaign using this catalog.
catalogSteps.5: Use dynamic creative so each ad card shows a different car from the catalog.
catalogSteps.6: Publish a test ad and click the selected car — it must open the Bilskyen detail URL.

marketplaceSteps.1: Use the same Vehicles catalog and CSV feed URL: {feedUrl}.
marketplaceSteps.2: In Commerce Manager, enable Marketplace distribution for the catalog (where available in your region).
marketplaceSteps.3: Ensure each vehicle has at least 2 images, mileage, dealer address, and state Used/New.
marketplaceSteps.4: Review Meta’s Marketplace vehicle policies and fix any rejected items.
marketplaceSteps.5: Confirm the listing for your selected car links to the Bilskyen detail page.

metaAdsGuide.marketplaceExample: Selected example vehicle: “{title}”. Fix any failed readiness checks before expecting Marketplace approval.

troubleshooting.1: Feed rejected: check required columns (make, model, year, mileage, image[0].url, price, url, state_of_vehicle).
troubleshooting.2: Missing cars: only published vehicles are included; run Sync now on Feeds & Syndication.
troubleshooting.3: Wrong landing page: each row’s url must be /vehicles/{slug} for that car.
troubleshooting.4: Pixel not firing: enable Meta Pixel in Admin → Integrations → Marketing and allow the domain in Events Manager.

syndication.title: Feeds & Syndication
syndication.subtitle: Manage export feeds and syndicate your inventory to external channels

help.page: This page exports your live vehicle inventory to other systems. Feed tokens provide secure JSON/XML URLs for your website or partners. Syndication automatically pushes stock to external marketplaces when you publish or update vehicles. Hover or tap the ! buttons for detailed guidance. Inventory Feeds and Syndication require the matching features on your subscription plan.
help.feedTokensSection: Feed tokens are secret keys that unlock read-only export URLs for your published stock. Each token generates unique JSON and XML links you can share with your web developer, price-comparison sites, or DMS — without giving them panel login access.
help.addToken: Creates a new feed token and generates fresh JSON/XML URLs. You can create multiple tokens (e.g. one per website or partner) and revoke access anytime by deleting a token. Treat feed URLs like passwords — anyone with the link can read your published inventory.
help.feedUrls: Use Copy next to JSON, XML, or CSV. CSV is for Meta Vehicles catalogs. URLs always reflect your current published vehicles.
help.formatJson: JSON format — structured data that is easy for websites, apps, and scripts to consume. Give this URL to your developer or CMS integration.
help.formatXml: XML format — widely used by legacy DMS systems and feed aggregators. Choose XML if your integration documentation specifically requests it.
help.providersSection: Syndication providers send your inventory to external sales channels (e.g. Facebook Marketplace) when vehicles are published or updated. Enable only the channels you use, save your settings, and use Sync now to force an immediate refresh.
help.providerToggle: Turn a provider on to start sending listings to that channel; turn it off to stop updates. Changes apply after you click Save. The last sync timestamp shows when that channel was last refreshed.
help.saveProviders: Saves which syndication channels are enabled for your dealership. This does not publish vehicles by itself — it only controls which external feeds receive updates when your stock changes.
help.syncNow: Forces an immediate sync for all enabled syndication providers. Use after bulk imports or if a partner reports missing vehicles. Normal publish and update actions sync automatically in the background.
help.recentLogs: Shows the latest syndication attempts per provider: success or error, time, and a short message. Use this to troubleshoot partner feed issues — repeated errors often mean a misconfiguration on the receiving side.
help.logTable: Each row is one sync attempt. Success means the feed was generated and delivered; Error means something failed (read the message column). Try Sync now once, then contact support if errors continue.
help.formatCsv: CSV format for Meta Vehicles catalogs (Marketplace / Catalog Ads). Paste this URL into Commerce Manager.

syndication.noTokens: No feed tokens yet. Create one to get JSON/XML/CSV feed URLs.
syndication.metaGuideBanner: Use the Meta Ads Guide for Catalog Ads and Marketplace with your vehicle feed.

branding.title: Branding & DMS
branding.subtitle: Customize your dealer storefront, reviews, API access, and inventory audit links.

help.page: This page controls how your dealership looks to buyers online and how your stock system connects to Bilskyen. Use the tabs to set colors, domains, Google reviews, API keys, webhooks, and a shareable inventory audit link. Hover or tap the ! buttons on each field for detailed guidance.
help.tabTheme: The Branding tab covers your public look: colors buyers see on vehicle pages, optional monthly payment calculator, finance partner link, and custom website domains (e.g. cars.yourcompany.dk).
help.tabReviews: The Reviews tab links your Google Business profile so you can send buyers to leave a review after a sale. Requires the Review Management feature on your subscription plan.
help.tabDms: The DMS & API tab is for technical connections: API keys let other software read or update your data securely; webhooks notify your DMS when a vehicle is published or updated.
help.tabAudit: The Inventory audit tab gives you a shareable link that shows your live stock on a page styled with your logo and colors — useful to email prospects or use in sales meetings.
help.saveBranding: Saves your theme colors, finance calculator setting, finance partner URL, and Google review fields to your dealer profile. Changes apply to your public storefront after saving.
help.themeSection: Branding & reputation settings control the visual identity and finance tools shown on your public vehicle listing pages that buyers see on the marketplace or your custom domain.
help.financeCalculatorEnabled: When enabled, each vehicle page can show an estimated monthly payment (based on price, rate, and term). Choose Inherit to follow the platform default, Enabled to always show it for your dealership, or Disabled to hide it. If the platform admin has turned the calculator off globally, this field is locked.
help.financePartnerUrl: Optional link to your finance partner or bank application page (full https URL). Buyers who want financing can be directed here from your listings. Leave blank if you handle finance enquiries only by phone or in person.
help.primaryColor: Your main brand color in hex format (e.g. #03418b). Used for buttons, links, and highlights on your public dealer pages and branded audit. Pick a color that matches your logo for a consistent look.
help.secondaryColor: A supporting brand color in hex format. Used for accents, backgrounds, or secondary UI elements on your public pages. Should complement your primary color.
help.domainsSection: Custom domains let buyers open your inventory on your own website address (e.g. stock.yourdealership.dk) instead of only the default Bilskyen URL. You must own the domain and add a DNS record at your domain provider.
help.cnameSetup: At your domain registrar (e.g. One.com, GoDaddy), create a CNAME record pointing your subdomain to the target shown here. DNS changes can take up to 24–48 hours. Until verified, the domain stays in Pending status.
help.addDomain: Enter the full domain or subdomain you want to use (e.g. cars.example.dk), then click Add. The domain appears in the list below. You must complete DNS setup and click Verify before it goes live.
help.domainVerification: Click Verify after you have added the CNAME record at your DNS provider. We check that the record points to our platform. Verified means the domain is ready; Pending means DNS is not correct yet or still propagating.
help.googleReviewUrl: The public Google review link for your dealership. Find it in Google Business Profile → Ask for reviews, or copy the ‘Write a review’ URL for your business. Buyers use this after a purchase to leave feedback on Google.
help.googlePlaceId: Your Google Place ID uniquely identifies your business location for Google APIs (optional but helps map widgets and review features). You can find it in Google’s Place ID finder or your Google Business settings.
help.apiAccessSection: API access lets approved software (your DMS, website, or custom tools) connect to Bilskyen programmatically. Each integration uses an API key — treat keys like passwords and never share them in email or public code.
help.apiEndpoint: This is the base URL your developers or DMS vendor use when calling the Bilskyen API on behalf of your dealership. Share this endpoint together with a newly created API key.
help.createApiKey: Generates a new secret API key. The full key is shown only once immediately after creation — copy and store it securely. If you lose it, delete the old key and create a new one. Name keys by purpose (e.g. ‘DMS production’).
help.apiKeySecurity: Listed keys show only a prefix (first characters) for identification. Delete keys you no longer use. Anyone with a valid key can access your API scope — revoke compromised keys immediately.
help.webhookSection: Webhooks send automatic HTTP notifications to your DMS or middleware when events happen in Bilskyen (e.g. a vehicle is published). Your system receives a POST request with event details so stock stays in sync without manual exports.
help.webhookUrl: The HTTPS URL on your server that should receive webhook POST requests. Must be publicly reachable and return a 2xx response. Use your DMS vendor’s documented webhook endpoint if they provide one.
help.addWebhook: Registers the URL above to receive vehicle.published and vehicle.updated events. After adding, publish or update a test vehicle to confirm your endpoint receives the payload. Remove webhooks that are no longer needed.
help.webhookEvents: vehicle.published fires when a listing goes live; vehicle.updated fires when key vehicle data changes. Your integration should handle both to keep external stock accurate.
help.recentDeliveries: Shows the last webhook delivery attempts: status (success/failed), event name, and HTTP response code from your server. Use this to debug connection issues — repeated failures often mean a wrong URL, firewall block, or server error.
help.exportPiiAudit: Downloads a CSV audit log of when lead personal data (PII) was accessed or exported in your account. Useful for GDPR compliance records and internal security reviews.
help.auditSection: The branded inventory audit is a read-only public page listing your current published vehicles with your dealership logo and colors. Share the link with prospects who want an overview without logging in.
help.auditShareUrl: Copy this link and send it by email, SMS, or embed in proposals. The page updates as your live inventory changes. Requires a dealer profile slug — contact support if link generation fails.
help.previewAudit: Opens the audit page in a new browser tab exactly as a prospect would see it. Check logo, colors, and vehicle list before sharing the link externally.

troubleshooting.1: Feed rejected: check required columns (make, model, year, mileage, image[0].url, price, url, state_of_vehicle).
troubleshooting.2: Missing cars: only published vehicles are included; run Sync now on Feeds & Syndication.
troubleshooting.3: Wrong landing page: each row’s url must be /vehicles/{slug} for that car.
troubleshooting.4: Pixel not firing: enable Meta Pixel in Admin → Integrations → Marketing and allow the domain in Events Manager.

help.page: This guide walks you through Meta Catalog Ads and Marketplace listing using Bilskyen’s vehicle CSV feed. Select a car to see a real example row and click-through URL.
help.overview: Catalog Ads are paid inventory ads. Marketplace listing can appear in Facebook Marketplace. Both use the same Vehicles catalog feed.
help.prerequisites: You need Meta Business access, published cars with complete data, and the CSV feed URL from Bilskyen.
help.feed: Meta fetches this URL to sync inventory. Keep feed tokens private — anyone with the URL can read published stock.
help.carSelector: Search your published stock. The preview uses the same mapper as the live Meta CSV feed.
help.readiness: Green checks meet Meta catalog requirements. Yellow warnings may block Marketplace or reduce ad quality.
help.catalogRow: This is the exact field set written into the Facebook catalog CSV for the selected vehicle.
help.catalogSteps: Follow these steps in Meta Ads/Commerce Manager. Bilskyen provides the feed; ads are created in Meta.
help.marketplaceSteps: Marketplace has stricter image and address rules. Fix readiness warnings on the selected car first.
help.troubleshooting: Most issues are incomplete vehicle data or an outdated feed. Sync feeds after bulk edits.
